name: groundwork-ios
description: Capacitor native shell for the GroundWork web app. The web app in TherapyTracker-web/ is the single source of truth; this wrapper never forks it.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/check-drift.mjs && node scripts/check-schedule-parity.mjs
scripts.sync: cap sync ios && node scripts/add-native-plugin.mjs && node scripts/register-native-plugin.mjs && node scripts/add-watch-target.mjs && node scripts/install-assets.mjs && node scripts/prune-public.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run check && npm run sync && cap open ios
